escena: SCENE (cinematic, a real long-exposure photograph of one night of campaign production inside a vast dark studio, the native layout of a vertical full-screen Stories and Reels ad). GEOGRAPHY, the most important instruction: the UPPER 40% of the frame is one continuous, evenly dark, deep navy-black matte studio wall with fine visible texture: no light falls on it, no pieces, no streaks, no glow, no bokeh and no objects; it is calm from edge to edge. Everything lit lives between 42% and 78% of the frame height. The LOWEST 22% of the frame is the near-black matte edge of a long production table right in front of the lens, crossing the whole width, completely out of focus, non-reflective, outside every light. THE MOMENT: behind her, a GIANT wall in deep perspective between 42% and 74% of the frame height holds HUNDREDS of pieces of ONE sale campaign for a fictitious fashion retailer: vertical stories, square posts, wide banners, email headers, product cards and a billboard, all in the same bold black-and-orange (#FF6500) visual system with the same product photography and the same diagonal composition, no letters, no numbers, no logos. During the exposure, new pieces flew in from the darkness and locked into place: they are drawn as long warm orange motion streaks that end exactly in their slot of the grid, while the pieces already placed are sharp and perfectly aligned. In the foreground, slightly RIGHT of center, a Latin American art director in her late twenties, dark hair in a low bun, wearing the Efeonce hoodie exactly as in its reference, framed from the waist up, the top of her head at about 46% of the frame height, the table edge cutting her at the waist, stands perfectly still and SHARP, holding a tablet at chest height with both arms fully visible: on it, ONE of the campaign pieces with a small approval check; she looks straight into the lens with calm confidence. LIGHT: the tablet is the key light on her face from below and the front right, warm; the streaks of the wall throw a warm orange rim on her shoulders; NO fill light, the far side of her face in shadow with the nose shadow legible. A cool azure (#0375DB) rim from a distant practical outlines her hair. Thin haze catches the streaks, only below 42%. A real face: natural skin with irregular pores, fine facial hair, even healthy tone, no retouching. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about two and a half meters away at chest height, 85mm, nothing foreshortened. Real long-exposure physics, real sensor grain, genuine depth of field. Enormous contrast, deep navy blacks. No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no percent signs, no logos of any brand.
